Use <nowiki>{{Tile|Mud}}</nowiki> or <nowiki>{{Tile|Deep water}}</nowiki> for a ground-tile sprite and linked terrain name.

Use a canonical terrain page title, not an ID or filename. Spaces, underscores and first-letter normalization are supported. Unknown names, namespaces and section fragments produce an error. A terrain kind without approved tile art displays its name link.
